channel.title: Total Recall
channel.description: Most recent updates to Total Recall

item.title: Version 0.7.0
item.description:
## Bug Fixes
- correctly resolve sub-group selection IDs containing colons (#26)
## Build
- Bump vite from 8.0.8 to 8.0.16 in /site (#29) - Bump js-yaml from 4.1.1 to 4.2.0 in /site (#38)
## CI
- gate releases behind PRs and harden Actions supply chain (#24) - report test coverage on pull requests (#28)
## Features
- per-row sparklines showing memory history in group list (#35) - VM region breakdown panel for selected process (vmmap-style) (#37)
## Testing
- extend coverage for instance merging, trends, formatting, and parsers (#27) - add coverage for ProcessSnapshot, SystemMemoryInfo, and ProcessActions (#36) - broad coverage expansion to reach 73% test coverage (#39)

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
## Bug Fixes
- derive icon from .app bundle path for terminal groups - add configure-pages step to deployment workflow (#3) - ad-hoc sign app bundle in release workflow (#4)
## Documentation
- add git and release conventions to CLAUDE.md
## Features
- separate Node.js framework groups (Next.js, NestJS) - process count label, column alignment, hide single-process chevrons - tree view toggle for subprocesses, show main PID in detail panel - group terminal-launched processes with their terminal app - sysctl fallback, shim resolution, tree-based group list (#2) - add GitHub Pages website with React + Vite (#1)
